# Government in Tribal Areas

<!-- STEP id="adc" -->
## Autonomous District Councils

The Constitution also protects tribal heritage. Specific north-eastern regions have **Autonomous District Councils (ADCs)**, with legislative and judicial authority to preserve tribal customs.

<!-- STEP id="pesa" -->
## The PESA Act, 1996

Tribal areas in other states have the **PESA Act** (Panchayats Extension to Scheduled Areas). It makes the **Gram Sabha**, the village assembly, the primary decision-making body.

**One national Constitution draws strength from the traditions of every community.**
